zones.name: Outer Perimeter & Concentric Ring
zones.description: Concentric double-walled desert fortress with adobe barriers (env_wall_adobe_4m) and guard booths (env_guard_booth_a), guarded by Buried Mines M09_T4_01 ([331.3, 430.7]) & M09_T4_02 ([383.1, 222.3]), Motion Sensors M09_T6_01 ([434.8, 453.9]) & M09_T6_02 ([486.6, 245.5]), and Tripwire Alarms M09_T1_01 ([227.8, 407.6]) & M09_T1_02 ([279.5, 199.2]).

zones.name: Inner Compound & Guard Barracks
zones.description: Internal compound housing the barracks, patrolling E2 Cobalt Grunts, and E3 Radio Officers, secured by Alarmed Doors M09_T13_01 ([201.9, 500.2]) and M09_T13_02 ([253.6, 291.8]).

zones.name: Central Uplink Bunker & Mainframe
zones.description: Reinforced underground bunker at [400.0, 400.0] containing the Main Uplink Terminal (Primary Objective O1 requiring 40s hack) and camera monitors M09_MON_01 linking to 4 panning/fixed cameras (M09_CAM_01 to M09_CAM_04).

zones.name: North Radar & Comms Camp
zones.description: Secondary command area with radar dish domes (env_radar_dish_dome) and officer tents (Secondary Objective S2 — destroy satellite/radar dish after the hack).

zones.name: South Detention & Barracks Camp
zones.description: Contains Tower B and the camp logbook (Secondary Objective S1 at [304.0, 400.0]).

zones.name: North Mountain Gorge Insertion
zones.description: Player Start Position at [400.0, 10.0] in the northern mountain gorge overlooking the summit snipers, with Extraction Point at the North-West Ridge [760.0, 40.0] (radius: 10.0m).

primary.title: Eliminate all 5 elite snipers in towers & hack uplink terminal at (400, 400)

secondary.title: Destroy the satellite dish with C4 or sniper fire after the hack (Ghost Medal)

extraction.title: Extract at North-West / North Ridge Outpost (760, 40)

events.description: At elapsed >= 480s, dusk darkens and all 4 tower searchlights power on across the concentric mountain base.
If any Ghillie Sniper (E6) is eliminated while unnoticed, surviving snipers enter a 6-second Alert 1 scan state.

silent.name: Silent Route (Counter-Snipe 5 Towers, Tower B Logbook S1 & West Bunker Doorway)
silent.description: Counter-snipe the 5 E6 tower snipers from [400, 10] -> advance West to [304, 110] -> climb Tower B at [304, 400] to take the S1 Logbook -> enter Central Bunker via West doorway [360, 400] to hack Uplink Terminal at [400, 400] -> exit North through [400, 110] -> extract at [760, 40].

technical.name: Technical Route (EMP T10 Searchlights & T6 Motion Sensors, PDA Hack & Satellite Dish S2)
technical.description: Advance from [400, 10] through North gate [400, 110] -> enter Central Bunker North doorway [400, 360] -> hack Uplink Terminal at [400, 400] & disable M09_MON_01 -> exit East doorway [440, 400] to [545, 400] -> sabotage/destroy Zone D Satellite Dish at [545, 185] (S2) -> extract at [760, 40].

loud.name: Loud Route (Direct Concentric Breach, Central Bunker Storm & C4 Satellite Dish Demolition)
loud.description: Push from [400, 10] to [400, 200] -> storm Central Uplink Bunker at [400, 400] -> push South to [400, 600] to clear Tower D -> sweep East to [680, 600] -> extract at [760, 40].
